list: The official 55 trophies as listed on PlayStation Network and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles (reported 2026-11-18), 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written in our own words and names its sources.
notes: No online trophies: the whole list is single-player. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so story trophies can be missed — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission (Output Lag trophy guide; PowerPyx). Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off your trophy save. Estimated platinum time is around 200 hours (Output Lag).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in this guide in order: story first with a manual save per chapter, then collectibles, then the long grinds like 250 stunts and 100% completion. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide.
sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Lucia and Jason. It unlocks very early in the story, so it is one of the first trophies most players earn. Because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save before you start the mission in case anything goes wrong. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: it is the one meditation spot that disappears after this chapter, and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude. Save manually at the start of the chapter. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide (Chapter 1 meditation warning).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions. From this chapter both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens up most of the open-world activities, so use the downtime between missions to start the collectibles and activities rather than leaving them all for after the story. Save manually at the chapter start. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 3. The chapter trophy unlocks as the story moves on, so there is no separate task — just keep playing the story missions in order and do not skip the optional stranger and side missions that feed other trophies. Keep your manual chapter-start save until the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. By now the story is near its end, so before the final mission, check the missable one-time trophies in this guide (partner robberies, the VCIA departure, the jewelry store) and earn any you still need while the world is still open to you. Save manually at the chapter start. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission to earn this gold trophy. Make a manual save before you start it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so this save is your only way back if you want to replay the ending or mop up anything the finale locks off. The trophy pops when the mission's end cutscene finishes. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide (no mission replay warning).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the story in order — follow the mission marker and finish the mission's objectives. With no mission replay, a manual save from the start of its chapter is your safety net. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to have setup steps before the main job, so finish the setups as they appear and the trophy will pop when the heist itself is done. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter in case you want another attempt at any part of it. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it comes from playing the story in order — there is no extra objective beyond finishing the mission. If you are hunting missables, do the mission carefully the first time, since there is no replay. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the mission as directed and finish it to the end; the trophy unlocks on completion. Because the game has no mission replay, treat every named story mission as a one-shot and keep a manual save per chapter. trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission's objectives in full — the trophy pops when the mission completes, not partway through. The airport also matters for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout for later. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story named mission, so play the story through in order and finish the mission to unlock it. Keep a manual save from the start of its chapter — with no mission replay, that save is the only way to redo it. trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist — this is the game's longest trophy and the second gold. The checklist covers the story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration; the pause menu's 100% tracker shows exactly which categories are still open, so check it after the story and clear the remaining items one category at a time. It is worth 100 Gamerscore on Xbox, the biggest single chunk of the 1,000 total. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide; GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 achievements.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. The fastest way is to chain jumps and airtime in a fast car on the highways and ramps around Vice City, and to use the stunt jumps scattered around the map. Your total is tracked in the stats menu, so check it there and grind the remainder after the story. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the game counts a type the first time you take part in it, so you do not need to win or finish first. Work through the activities the world offers (races, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest) and the trophy pops when the ninth type is sampled. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are several ranges around Leonida, each with its own set of challenges across weapon types, and gold means beating the top score threshold on every one. Learn each challenge's target pattern, use the steadiest weapon for the range, and retry the ones you silver until they turn gold — the range keeps your best medal per challenge. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course; winning means finishing first against the rival drones. Learn the course on a practice run, then cut corners through the gates cleanly — crashing costs more time than a cautious line saves. The game tracks which locations you have won, so sweep them one by one. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so repeating one easy race twenty times does not count. Race across the map's street, off-road and water events, pick a fast, well-handling vehicle for each, and keep a mental list of the ones you have already won. Race wins also feed the 100% checklist, so this pairs naturally with the platinum run. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and take his challenge, then out-fish him: cast where the fish are biting, keep the tension in the green while reeling, and do not let the line snap. It is a single head-to-head win, so one good catch can settle it. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game in full at an arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest game on the machine, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through to its end screen — starting one does not count, finishing it does. Arcade games also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's mission strand. Side-character strands unlock as you progress the story; follow Andy's missions through to their last one and the trophy pops when it ends. Finish the whole strand before the story's final mission, in case the finale locks strands off. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear on the map, and take the last one as soon as it unlocks so it is not left behind when the story ends. Like the other character strands, it is a story-gated chain with no replay. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Billy's missions appear as you move through the story; clear each one when it shows up and finish the strand before the finale. trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the returning Strangers & Freaks side content. Stranger missions show up as question marks on the map; each strand is a short chain, and it only counts when the whole chain is done. There are more than 8 strands in the state, so pick the shortest ones first and finish them during the story, not after the finale. trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Follow Randy's mission chain through to its end and take the final mission as soon as it appears, before the story moves past it. It is one of the named character-strand trophies, so it pops on completion of that last mission. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Clear Tyrone's missions as they unlock and finish the chain before the final story mission. As with every character strand, there is no replay — a manual save at the start of the chapter is your only second chance. trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The one missable in the whole list: Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, so do it before Chapter 1 ends or it is gone for the playthrough — there is no mission replay. The other 17 spots stay available, so sweep them with a map guide after the story. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide (the Chapter 1 balcony warning).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at a specific rare animal — track it in its habitat, approach downwind and quietly, and take a clean shot so the pelt and the kill both count. Bring a scoped rifle and patience; spooking the animal sends it running and costs you the attempt. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses, vehicles and out in the wild — and each set needs every card in it. Collect with a map guide, trade duplicates if the game allows it, and finish three sets; you do not need every set in the game, just three complete ones. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo/check-in style collectible: open it at landmarks, viewpoints and notable spots and the location ticks off. Work through the map region by region with a location guide so you do not revisit the same spots — only new locations count toward the 100. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — the rotating and long-term objectives in the pause menu. Pick the easy ones first (driving, exploration, simple combat and activity challenges), and let the harder ones fill in naturally as you play. Your completed count is shown in the challenges menu, so check it before grinding the last few. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Commit crimes together until four stars show, then break line of sight — duck into alleys, swap cars, and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. Do it while the story still has you working as a pair, and save beforehand so a busted attempt costs you nothing. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the streak only counts if the heat stays on the whole time. Pick three shops close together, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next without stopping to fight the police or hide. If the stars drop, the chain breaks and you start over. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each new model once and it counts. Leonida is full of variety, so this fills in naturally if you steal and drive something new whenever you see it instead of always taking the same car. Check your vehicle log in the stats to see how many you still need, and hunt the rare spawns last. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang hideout or a police ambush — trigger Combat Focus when five are in view, and drop them all before the meter runs out. A heavy weapon with good damage per shot makes five kills in one window realistic. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — get a plane off the ground without going through the normal gates and runways. Steal a small plane from the airfield, taxi to a clear stretch and take off while the airport security reacts. Expect a wanted level the moment you do it, so have an escape route planned. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks — get into trouble with one, or take one on, until the trophy pops. The description is a joke about the heat inside a Rhino, and the unlock is tied to tank action: steal a Rhino from the military base or survive a tank encounter, and the game will credit it. Save first, since military responses escalate fast. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide (no confirmed method at launch — the description is the only confirmed fact).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Go in quiet, take the goods without smashing cases in view of cameras or staff, and slip out before anyone notices. Scout the store first in normal play so you know the camera and guard positions, then do the clean run in one go. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big planned robberies: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and get out clean before the police lock the area down. Plan a fast getaway car for each bank, and do the five across different banks around Leonida rather than repeating one. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the state — spot one, block it or force it to stop, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. A sticky bomb or a hard ram into a wall stops the truck; a fast car parked nearby makes the escape. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Every named district, town and stretch of countryside counts once you have set foot in it, and the map fills in as you go. The efficient route is a road trip after the story: drive the coast, then sweep the interior and the keys, checking the map's area list for the ones still grey. trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own off-books operations around Leonida — find one per gang, hit it and get out with the goods. Work gang by gang with a map guide, since the operations are spread across the whole state and each gang's territory is different. trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find the bar or beach spot on Ocean Drive with the ocean view, order the cocktail and let the scene play out. trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — go bowling there and finish a game. The alley is a full activity venue: rent a lane, bowl your frames and complete the game to the end. trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a trophy tied to a specific duo moment with your partner that the description keeps vague. It most likely pops from a story or side moment where the two of you do something the public notices, so play the partner missions fully and watch for a scene where your partnership draws a crowd. trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. This trophy tracks the choices you make across the story; PlayStation tracks a count toward 500, so it is a long accumulation rather than one decision. Keep playing, choose actively whenever the game offers a fork, and it will pop once the count is reached. With no mission replay, choices you skip are gone, so do not rush past decision moments. trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. The natural way is to fail a mission objective or a challenge, then clear it on the retry; the trophy credits the comeback. Do not force it early — it will come on its own during a long playthrough — but if it has not popped by the end of the story, retry a failed challenge deliberately. trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — witness something strange in Leonida. This is the game's oddity trophy: a UFO, a cryptid, a weird event in the wilds or a strange encounter somewhere off the beaten track. Explore the remote corners of the map at night and investigate anything out of place; it is designed to surprise you, so it will most likely pop while you are doing something else entirely. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee weapon while driving past. Equip a melee weapon, drive slowly alongside a pedestrian, and swing as you pass so the hit connects and drops them like a bowling pin. Pick a quiet street so the police do not turn a joke into a chase. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your laundering contacts, who clean them for a cut, and the cleaned total counts toward the $250,000. Keep laundering after every big score instead of sitting on dirty money, and it adds up across the whole playthrough. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, ammo, food and everything else counts. This fills in naturally over a full playthrough if you buy gear as you go; if you are short at the end, buy expensive weapons and ammo to top it up. The game tracks total spending, so every shop purchase moves the needle. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages go on sale as you progress and cost serious money, so save up and buy each one when it appears on the property market. Owning them also gives you somewhere to store the 100 vehicles for Whip It Good, so buy early and use them. Sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list; Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 trophies guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you own or find — open it, pick a vehicle and register it, then repeat with nine more. Any ten vehicles count, so use the cheap and common ones first and keep the rare finds for your garage.
